In the NFL, **typical linebacker jersey numbers** are **50–59**, with **90–99** also allowed if needed.[1] Current NFL rules are broader now: linebackers can wear **0–59** and **90–99**.[3]

A quick historical note: the league previously allowed linebackers **40–49** as well, but that was part of an earlier numbering system.[3][5]

If you meant **“what numbers do linebackers usually wear in practice/common tradition?”**, the classic look is still **the 50s or 90s**.[1][4]
